query_selection.rationale: Highest recurring billing vocabulary (stripe/billing/subscription/invoice/webhook) among candidate pools at 90-signal collector cap; 113 Algolia nbHits; 47 Ask HN threads with Stripe/billing in title in probe.

top_lane_relevant_complaints.thread_title: Ask HN: Migrating from Recurly to Stripe Billing
top_lane_relevant_complaints.summary: The user expresses dissatisfaction with Recurly's high costs and limited checkout customization, prompting consideration of a migration back to Stripe billing.
top_lane_relevant_complaints.verbatim_excerpt: Recurly is expensive. It's nearly our largest software line item.

top_lane_relevant_complaints.thread_title: Ask HN: Why can't OpenAI, Cursor, Fyxer etc. send their invoices per email?
top_lane_relevant_complaints.summary: The user is frustrated with the lack of email automation for invoice delivery from SaaS platforms using Stripe Billing.
top_lane_relevant_complaints.verbatim_excerpt: Every month I need to log in in to our SaaS to download invoices.

top_lane_relevant_complaints.thread_title: Ask HN: Kicked off Stripe. Where else can I go?
top_lane_relevant_complaints.summary: The user was classified as high risk and removed from Stripe, seeking alternatives for SaaS billing.
top_lane_relevant_complaints.verbatim_excerpt: I just got kicked off Stripe; classified as high risk.

top_lane_relevant_complaints.thread_title: Ask HN: Why most SaaS companies are leaving money on table
top_lane_relevant_complaints.summary: The user expresses frustration over the lack of subscription management support for various payment methods, which limits revenue potential.
top_lane_relevant_complaints.verbatim_excerpt: Why there isn't any subscription management product which supports all of these gateways?

top_lane_relevant_complaints.thread_title: Ask HN: A payment processor that pre-charges metered use

top_lane_relevant_complaints.verbatim_excerpt: Is there a processor (ideally as easy to work with as Stripe) that supports this type of billing?

top_lane_relevant_complaints.summary: The user is seeking advice on preventing credit card fraud on their online selling platform, indicating they have experienced unauthorized transactions.

top_lane_relevant_complaints.summary: The user is frustrated with Stripe's inability to track usage-based billing per subscription, which is crucial for their business model.
